主要内容: Electrolux AB announced that Chief Executive Officer Keith McLoughlin will step down after the company failed to secure a $3.3 billion deal to acquire General Electric Co.'s household goods business. McLoughlin, 59, cited family reasons for his decision to retire and move back to the U.S., where he will continue to work for Electrolux on a consultancy basis. Jonas Samuelson, who leads the company’s major appliance operations in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, will take over as CEO. Samuelson will focus on product development and cost controls for the maker of fridges, ovens, and dishwashers. The failed GE deal marked the end of a 15-month pursuit by Electrolux.
